---
title: "حسینؑ والے یہ اعلانِ عام کرتے ہیں"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Hussain walay ye ailan e aam kartay hain
Ham apnay ashkon ko Zehra ke naam kartay hain

1
Haqeeqaton ke fasany chupa nahi saktay
Zaban e khalq pe khanjar chala nahi saktay
Hamaray khoon ke qatray kalam kartay hain

2
Khushi ke lab hain teh e tegh zulm beet gaye
Yazeed haar gaya aur Hussain jeet gaye
Isi khabar ko zamany may aam kartay hain

3
Saja ke mashk e Sakina jari ke parcham may
Ghamon ki aag lagi di tamam aalam may
Yazeed e waqt ka jeena haram kartay hain

4
Ba fazl e Fatima Zehra Hussain ke sadqay
Lab e Khaleel pe lab par Mujeeb ke noha
Hussainio ke dilon may qayam kartay hain

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/husain-wale-ye-aalan-aam-krte-hain.md'
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + p], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
_, front, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert roman == original
groups = lambda s: [g.splitlines() for g in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(g) for g in groups(roman)] == [len(g) for g in groups(body)] == [2, 4, 4, 4, 4]
assert [g[0] for g in groups(body)[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴')
print('Verified unchanged Roman transcription and matching stanza structure.')
PY"

Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the original Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Checked that the opening and four numbered stanzas match line for line. Added the Roman title, set right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read `jari` as `جری` and retained the unusual wording `lagi di` as `لگی دی`.
